facts.fact_text: The applicants participated in an assembly on 6 May 2014.
When the Baku Assize Court announced its judgment on 6 May 2014, those who had gathered outside began to protest against the judgment, considering it unfair.
According to the applicants, the protest on 6 May 2014 near the Baku Assize Court was brief, spontaneous and peaceful.
Immediately after the protesters started chanting slogans on 6 May 2014, police officers and people in plain clothes began to forcibly disperse the demonstration near the Baku Assize Court.
The applicants were arrested during the dispersal operation on 6 May 2014.
After their arrest, the applicants were taken to a police station.
The applicants were kept overnight at the police station.
The applicants were questioned at the police station.
On 6 May 2014, the day of the applicants' arrest, administrative-offence reports (inzibati xəta haqqında protokol) were issued against the applicants.
At the time of the applicants' arrest, under Article 5 § IV of the Law on Freedom of Assembly of Azerbaijan of 13 November 1998, no prior written notification was required for spontaneous assemblies.

Before amendments introduced by Law no. 462-IVQD of 2 November 2012, a breach of the rules on the organisation and holding of assemblies was punishable under Article 298 of the Code of Administrative Offences of Azerbaijan of 2000 by a reprimand or a fine of seven to thirteen Azerbaijani manats (AZN).
Law no. 462-IVQD of 2 November 2012 entered into force on 1 January 2013.
Law no. 462-IVQD of 2 November 2012 introduced new wording to Article 298 of the Code of Administrative Offences of Azerbaijan on breaching the rules on the organisation and holding of assemblies.

Following the amendment introduced by Law no. 462-IVQD of 2 November 2012, participation in an assembly organised in breach of the rules on the organisation and holding of assemblies became explicitly punishable under Article 298.2 of the Code of Administrative Offences of Azerbaijan.

Law no. 462-IVQD of 2 November 2012 introduced, for the first time, punishments in the form of administrative detention of up to 15 days or community service for participation in an assembly organised in breach of the rules on the organisation and holding of assemblies under Article 298.2 of the Code of Administrative Offences of Azerbaijan.

Law no. 462-IVQD of 2 November 2012 increased the fine for a breach of the rules on the organisation and holding of assemblies, fixing the amounts as follows: between AZN 300 and AZN 600 for participants of an assembly; AZN 1,500 to AZN 3,000 for individuals who organise an assembly; AZN 3,000 to AZN 6,000 for persons in charge (vəzifəli şəxslər) who organise an assembly; and between AZN 15,000 and AZN 30,000 for legal entities involved in the organisation of an assembly.

By Law no. 651-IVQD of 14 May 2013, which entered into force on 5 June 2013, the administrative detention sentence provided for in Article 298.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences of Azerbaijan was increased to 'up to two months'.

By Law no. 651-IVQD of 14 May 2013, which entered into force on 5 June 2013, the administrative detention sentence provided for in Article 298.2 of the Code of Administrative Offences of Azerbaijan was increased to 'up to two months'.
The Nasimi District Court sentenced the first applicant to a period of administrative detention of thirty days.
The Nasimi District Court sentenced the second applicant to a period of administrative detention of twenty days.
On 16 May 2014, the Baku Court of Appeal dismissed the first applicant's appeal and upheld the decision of the Nasimi District Court in her case.
On 22 May 2014, the Baku Court of Appeal dismissed the second applicant's appeal and upheld the decision of the Nasimi District Court in his case.
